title: The Woman on the Gravestone (1991)

lines.text: August 10th, 1991. Ghost hunters photographed this empty gravestone.
Abandoned, inside a forest preserve, and badly vandalised.
Locals tell of floating lights, and a farmhouse that vanishes as you approach.
That night, the Ghost Research Society said its equipment acted strangely here.
One member was shooting black-and-white infrared film in that spot.
Nobody saw anyone on the stone.
A woman. See-through. Seated on the gravestone, in an old-fashioned dress.
It became one of the most famous ghost photos ever taken.
Sceptics suspect a double exposure: two images on one frame.
Nobody has proved it either way.
All we know is that on

shots.description: Cold open, frame 1 already moving. Cemetery clearing: ~25 headstones as simple boxes/slabs (0.6-1.0 m tall, some tilted 5-15 degrees, three broken in half, one lying flat), low grass (particle hair or noise-displaced plane), bare trees (forest builder) ringing the clearing. HERO STONE front-centre: squat box 0.9x0.25x0.75 m with a checkerboard pattern carved on its face (checker texture, 8x6), no name, empty. INFRARED GRADE: monochrome, foliage and grass glow near-white, sky and shadows near-black, heavy grain, slight halation. WRONG DETAIL (subtle): a single patch of grass in front of the hero stone is flattened, as if something sat or stood there.
shots.camera: slow push-in toward the hero stone, 35 mm, 1.3 m height (camera-at-chest height), starts moving at frame 1
shots.lighting: flat, soft (IR look): one big sun/area light low from camera left, everything else black

shots.description: Natural-colour night. A narrow woodland lane (road builder, broken asphalt) ends at a chain-link fence (thin boxes + wire texture) with an open gate; bare trees close over it. A map overlay pins the location southwest of Chicago.
shots.camera: slow walk-in toward the gate, 28 mm, handheld light
shots.lighting: cold moonlight (sun light, blue, low), no artificial light

shots.description: Cemetery clearing: ~25 headstones as simple boxes/slabs (0.6-1.0 m tall, some tilted 5-15 degrees, three broken in half, one lying flat), low grass (particle hair or noise-displaced plane), bare trees (forest builder) ringing the clearing. HERO STONE front-centre: squat box 0.9x0.25x0.75 m with a checkerboard pattern carved on its face (checker texture, 8x6), no name, empty. Natural-colour night version (not IR): the broken and toppled stones in the foreground, one slab split in two, a stone base with its headstone missing; the hero stone small in the background.
shots.camera: slow lateral dolly right along the broken stones, 28 mm, low 0.5 m

shots.description: Fog between bare trees at the cemetery edge. Three small blue-white orbs (emissive spheres + weak point lights) drift at head height. Beyond them, a pale one-storey farmhouse with a porch and a porch light (house_exterior simplified to one storey) glows in the fog; as the camera pushes forward the house shrinks and fades out completely.
shots.camera: slow push forward, 35 mm; the house is scaled down + faded via keyframes as camera advances
shots.lighting: fog glow; porch light warm; orbs cold blue

shots.description: Three faceless investigator silhouettes (char_figure, early-90s jackets) among the stones with flashlight cones. One holds a small meter (box with an LED + needle) whose LED flickers rapidly; they all turn toward the hero stone.
shots.camera: medium wide over the shoulder of the meter holder, 35 mm, slight handheld

shots.description: Macro: a 35 mm SLR camera (box body 14x9x5 cm + cylinder lens + pentaprism wedge) being raised to eye level by a faceless figure's gloved hand; a small film canister labelled 'IR' (no brand) on the stone ledge beside it.
shots.camera: macro 85 mm, slow orbit 15 degrees, shallow depth of field

params.sub: per the GRS account (35 mm, IR film)

shots.description: Viewfinder POV: INFRARED GRADE: monochrome, foliage and grass glow near-white, sky and shadows near-black, heavy grain, slight halation. The hero stone centred in a viewfinder frame (overlay black mask with focusing circle). EMPTY. Shutter fires: 2-frame white flash.
shots.camera: POV, 50 mm, tiny handheld drift then still

params.sub: no one seen at the time

shots.description: Small darkroom (room 2x2.5 m): red safelight, three developing trays (flat boxes), a print in the middle tray seen edge-on and out of focus as liquid ripples over it; the image is never readable.
shots.camera: slow push across the trays, 50 mm, shallow depth of field

shots.description: The IR hero stone, empty, closer than S01. A document card types the description of the 1991 photo over it. The empty stone is the point: the viewer pictures her.

overlay.text:
Woman, partly transparent
Seated on the checkered stone
Old-fashioned dress

shots.description: Generic magazine/list spread (no real masthead, no real photos): a grid of six empty grey photo frames with numbers; frame '#5' lights up and its caption types 'Bachelor's Grove, 1991'.

params.sub: on lists of famous ghost photos

shots.description: Evidence board, card 'WHAT SCEPTICS SAY'. Motion graphic: two translucent rectangles (one: empty stone outline, one: a vague pale seated silhouette shape, NOT the real figure) slide together and merge into one frame.

overlay.text:
Double exposure?
Two images, one frame

shots.description: Back to the IR wide, EXACT S01 framing (end position of the S01 push). Stone empty. Music drops out; the shot holds through a 0.9 s dead-air pause, only faint wind.

DEAD-AIR REVEAL: identical-framing match-cut out of the silence. A pale, faceless, partly transparent seated figure (char_figure seated pose, long dress, no face, white emissive 20%, alpha 50%) is now sitting on the hero stone, head turned slightly away. She fades up over 1 s and does not move. Our recreation, not the 1991 photo.
characters: pale seated figure (faceless, translucent, long dress)

shots.description: Loop frame: identical to S01 frame 1 (stone empty, the flattened grass patch still there). Begins the same push-in so the cut back to L01 is seamless.
shots.camera: match S01 start position, begin the same push
